c1_phase: Absolute phase through unit complex Re/Im; no angle regression, no gauge/reference, no held-out alignment. Predicted vector norm <1e-8 falls back to +1+0i. Predicted amplitude is amp_ref*expm1(max(predicted log amplitude,0)); numerical upper clip 50 only prevents overflow.
candidate_rule: First report original H1 conjunctive gates. If both candidates fail, assess state/routing change and geometry-tail deterioration as research evidence only; no new combined admission score, no significance test treating folds/wavelengths/seeds as independent.

C0.architecture: frozen M5 exact 6-32-32 encoder, seven local 2-score heads, 14-32-14 residual cross-order fusion
C0.name: Cartesian matched control

C1.architecture: same width-32 encoder; seven local 4-score heads; 28-32-28 residual cross-order fusion; no hidden-width increase
C1.name: amplitude plus circular absolute phase
C1.representation: each order: rank-2 PCA of log1p(nonnegative amplitude/ref) across 42 wavelength-coordinate values, and rank-2 PCA of absolute unit-phase Re/Im across 84 values; retain TE/TM separately

inner_split: same three existing grouped geometry splits inside each outer training set
loss: C0 exactly frozen M5 standardized rank-2 latent MSE. C1 fixed equal-weight sum: standardized latent MSE + train-scaled log-amplitude reconstruction MSE + binary-strong-truth masked circular loss mean(1-Re(Uhat*conj(Utrue))) + complex reconstruction MSE divided by outer-train mean |C_hat|^2. No SSE-derived weights or posthoc tuning.
metrics: Original conjunctive H1 gates; per geometry state/routing/absolute/thresholded/P_scale; amplitude/circular/relative phase; paired geometry deltas and tails; same-scale P_scale comparison; frozen H2 physical reconstruction.
optimizer: CPU AdamW lr 0.002, weight_decay 0.0001; grad norm clip 5; max 320 epochs; patience45 on inner-validation standardized latent MSE (both configs); refit at median of three inner-fold best epochs for each seed.
outer_split: exact existing 32-fold geometry LOGO manifest; every wavelength for a geometry held together
pca: All bases fit on the current model-fit training geometries only; C0/C1 outer-train rank-2 bases refit within every outer fold. Compression ceilings are separately measured using held-out truth projections and labeled oracle ceilings.
polar_roundtrip: Uses original truth amplitude and unit phase, including weak but nonzero amplitudes; exact C_hat round trip must pass 1e-12. The deterministic +1 weak rule applies to C1 fit targets/loss only; its effect is separately reported in the C1 compression ceiling.
scale_branch: reuse exact archived 32G OOF RBF KRR P_scale prediction for all candidates; no oracle scale and no retraining.
scientific_scope: 32G ordered D1..D6; integrated periodic plane-wave FDTD truth already on disk; geometry-only forward; P/XLIKE; TE/TM complex outgoing coordinates; 440-460 nm
weak_amplitude_rule: At each geometry/wavelength, weak iff a truth coordinate amplitude <=0.01*maximum amplitude across all 14 TE/TM/order coordinates (max floor 1e-30). Weak phase labels deterministically +1+0i; only their circular training-loss weight is zero. Masks used in optimization are generated only from fit-subset truth. Validation selects epochs by standardized latent MSE only.
